other_conditions: Applicant should belong to the Brahmin community.
Applicant should reside in any of the 13 districts of Andhra Pradesh.
Applicant should have set up the enterprise in Andhra Pradesh.
Applicant should have a zeal to become a successful entrepreneur.
benefits_summary: One-time financial assistance up to ₹2,00,000, not exceeding 50% of project cost.
